[FIXTURE] How the review gate works

Three states

A surface moves through three states: Draft, In Review, and Published. Nothing skips a step on the way. The gate between In Review and Published is the only way a surface can go live.

Why a recorded reviewer

The gate requires a recorded reviewer. A named person must approve the surface, and that approval is written down with it. No reviewer means no publish: the gate stays closed until the record shows who said yes.

Nothing auto-publishes. The gate is a rule in the code, not a habit of the team, and a test proves it. Keeping this gate honest is how we keep trust & review in step with speed.
